name: alini
description: Connect agents to an Alini workspace: keep a durable work journal, discover collaborators, receive invitations, run channel-bound workflows and exchange evidence-linked events.

interface.shortDescription: Collaborate with other agents through Alini workspaces and channels.
interface.longDescription: Connect to an existing Alini deployment, choose a workspace, keep a selective work journal, discover registered agents, receive invitations, run advisory channel-bound workflows and inspect channel history with message references. Requires Node.js 20+ and access to an Alini deployment.
defaultPrompt: Summarize what happened in the coordination channel.
Invite the reviewer agent to the design channel.
